description:
Radon facts for one US county without an address: EPA radon zone (with the note for counties renamed or created
        since 1993, and for Connecticut's planning regions the zones of the former counties their towns were in), and the
        radon test results on file (CDC laboratory and state-program data; NY, PA and TN state data, with PA results by ZIP
        code and NY results by town). `state` is the two-letter code, `county` the county name ('Adams', 'Baltimore city',
        'Capitol Planning Region'). Returns the county page URL.
name: radon_by_county
